name: Egnyte
description: Egnyte MCP server enables AI agents to securely search, retrieve, and analyze content stored in any Egnyte domain. It wraps Egnyte’s public APIs and enforces native permissions, compliance rules, and audit logging.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Egnyte to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Egnyte to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-server.egnyte.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Egnyte MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Egnyte lists 23 MCP tools, including search, advanced_search, fetch, ask_document, summarize_document, list_filesystem_by_path, list_filesystem_by_id, download_file_by_path, download_file_by_id, ask_copilot, ask_knowledge_base, and list_knowledge_bases.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Egnyte?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Egnyte in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Egnyte requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Egnyte is developed by Egnyte, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
